name: Mechatronic
description: Builds a [color=#E92031]Redstone Golem[/color], a walking war machine of stone and redstone. [color=#E92031]Golem Mode[/color]: right click to summon it or use its Super Move, left click to give orders, Sneak + right click to recall it.

badge.name: Redstone Golem
badge.description: Summons the [color=#E92031]Redstone Golem[/color]. It draws the attention of enemies within 12 blocks and wears your armor. Left click orders it: a creature to attack, a block to hold, Sneak to follow. Running straight, it drops to all fours and gathers speed. Hold Jump in the air to rocket up, then glide. Broken down, it is rebuilt after 60s.

commons.name: Redstone Furnace
commons.description: Its blows stoke the furnace. Fully stoked, it flies into a Primal Rage: a roar raises a Cube Field around it that stops enemy projectiles, then for 6s it moves 50% faster, hits 50% harder, throws foes much further and sets them on fire. Left alone, the heat drains away.

commons.name: Saddle
commons.description: Right click the Golem to ride it. Left click: its lift. Right click: its Super Move. Hold Jump to charge a jump, a long leap while it runs; press Jump again in the air to rocket. Sneak: get off.

adept.name: Piston Arm
adept.description: Super Move: both fists come down like pistons, 14 damage to everything within 4 blocks in front. Cooldown 6s.

adept.name: Dispenser Arm
adept.description: Super Move: its arms become cannons, one homing bolt each, 6 damage. Cooldown 5s.

master.name: Ministrosities
master.description: When it blows, 3 Ministrosities scramble up out of the ground to fight beside it. They crumble when it goes.

master.name: Supercharged
master.description: In its Primal Rage it crackles with arcs: every blow it lands arcs on to up to 3 more enemies within 5 blocks, 5 damage each, and it takes 30% less damage.

grandmaster.name: Stride Servos
grandmaster.description: Its stride gathers faster and runs further: 1.9x speed in 1.2s (1.5x in 2s without).

grandmaster.name: Rocket Boots
grandmaster.description: Its rockets burn longer and climb harder: 2.4s of thrust (1.6s without).
